mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 5.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 5.5%, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts and retail sales (HOUST and RSAFS) indicates weakening consumer demand, which reduces corporate revenue expectations and causes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the Rank IC for the interaction falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL above 195.0) signals that the Federal Reserve will tighten monetary policy, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 195.0, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 100 (INDPRO < 100) indicates a contraction in the manufacturing sector, which reduces corporate output and profits, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO falls below 100, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and increase in non-farm payrolls (UNRATE falling and PAYEMS rising) indicates a tight labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE falls and PAYEMS rises, or the Rank IC for the interaction falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals strong consumer demand for housing, which boosts related sectors and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST rises, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a regime of industrial contraction (INDPRO < 100), a further decline in manufacturing output reduces corporate profitability and causes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is below 100, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
